title: New Year in Las Vegas 2027: Fremont, Bellagio and the Neon Museum
description: Plan New Year in Las Vegas 2027 with Fremont’s ticketed 21+ party, Bellagio’s holiday garden and the Neon Museum: dates, booking rules and a practical itinerary.
relatedQueries: Las Vegas New Year 2027 things to do
intro: For New Year in Las Vegas 2027, decide where you want to be at midnight before filling the rest of your trip. This guide pairs three places that serve different purposes: Fremont Street Experience for a ticketed party restricted to adults aged 21 and over, Bellagio Conservatory for a seasonal garden display, and The Neon Museum for the signs that help explain the city’s identity. The celebration welcoming 2027 takes place on Thursday, December 31, 2026, into Friday, January 1, 2027.

A workable trip depends on understanding each booking. A Fremont admission does not automatically open the doors to other venues. A museum visit is not a party running until midnight, and Bellagio’s garden calendar is separate from its dining reservations. The dates below come from the organizers’ current information. Our documentary photographs are archival: they identify the actual places without passing off earlier installations as this season’s decorations. Give the celebration one evening and leave the other visits enough room to be enjoyable.

sections.heading: 1. Fremont Street Experience: give the canopy celebration a full evening
paragraphs: Choose Fremont if you want live music and a street-party setting within an organized event. Its illuminated canopy gives downtown a distinctive setting, different from the larger hotel complexes along the Strip. The current Countdown Under The Canopy page carries the official New Year 2027 branding and announces doors opening at 7 p.m. on December 31. Hoobastank and Petey Pablo are among the advertised performers. The organizer’s conditions allow changes to the lineup and performance times, so make your choice around the overall event rather than a particular stage slot that may change.

This is strictly a 21+ event, and valid identification is required. The current page says wristbands can be collected before December 31 at the SlotZilla box office, with ticket confirmation and each ticket holder present. Identification is checked again at event entry on the night. Arrange this process before committing to a long dinner or an out-of-town excursion. Your purchase confirmation, wristband and identification serve different purposes; follow the instructions for all three. The linked conditions make sales final and require security screening. Check the total including fees before paying, and do not assume drinks, VIP benefits or admission to other venues are included.

sections.heading: 2. Bellagio Conservatory: the holiday display continues into January
paragraphs: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens adds floral design to a trip that could otherwise revolve entirely around nightlife. The hotel announces Holiday 2026, titled Postcards From Christmas, from November 14, 2026, through January 2, 2027. Those dates leave a specific opportunity on January 1 or 2 if you arrive late on December 31. The attraction is the way planting, materials and composition transform an indoor garden, offering a different scale and pace from the signs and stages of downtown.

Do not save this visit for January 3. Bellagio lists January 3–8 as a changeover period before its Lunar New Year installation. Also distinguish a garden visit from The Garden Table, a separate bookable dining experience advertised on the same page. If you want that meal, check the availability and terms of that particular product. For a garden walk, consult the hotel’s current access instructions for your date. We have not verified special New Year’s Eve visiting hours for the Conservatory, which is why this itinerary places it before the main celebration or on the following day rather than promising entry at midnight.

sections.heading: 3. The Neon Museum: discover the signs behind the city
paragraphs: The Neon Museum offers something the hotel screens cannot: a closer look at the typography, shapes and names that defined earlier versions of Las Vegas. It suits an interest in design, photography or urban history as well as a holiday itinerary. The published address is 770 Las Vegas Boulevard North. Although the museum also belongs to the downtown part of the trip, treat getting there as a separate journey and admission, rather than another attraction covered by your Fremont wristband.

The institution says it opens 365 days a year, recommends advance booking and releases tickets 60 days ahead. None of that establishes availability for your preferred slot or promises a midnight session. Select a real time in the booking calendar and allow enough time to arrive. There is a relevant rule for January 1 visitors: from that date in 2027, admission before or after the selected time may carry a higher price and require an additional payment. Check the photography rules as well; ordinary phone photography is different from permission for professional equipment or a production. The museum is cashless, and outdoor areas may be affected by unsafe weather.

sections.heading: Book the commitment that determines the rest of the trip first
paragraphs: Start with the decision that shapes everything else: Fremont’s party or a different celebration you arrange independently. If you choose Fremont, confirm that every member of the group is at least 21 and accepts the final-sale conditions before buying. Then settle accommodation and your museum slot. Any dinner reservation needs to fit between those commitments. Avoid a string of consecutive bookings that works only if you cross the city without delays. Bellagio makes a better flexible visit within the confirmed display dates than a tightly timed stop immediately before the party.

Break your budget into accommodation including compulsory charges, event admission and fees, museum tickets, food, transport and a contingency. We do not set a fixed New Year ticket price here because sales phases and checkout totals can change. An advertised promotion also does not prove enough tickets remain in that category for your whole group. Save the exact description of what you purchase. Fremont’s conditions prohibit outside food and drinks, so eat before entering and check the permitted options inside. General admission should not be treated as a dinner-and-open-bar package unless the product explicitly says so.

sections.heading: Downtown and the Strip: choose one base for December 31
paragraphs: These three places do not form a compact walking circuit for the final hour of the year. Bellagio belongs to the Strip part of the city, while Fremont and the museum form the downtown side of this itinerary. If Fremont is your principal reservation, consider accommodation that reduces the journey back from that area. If you stay near Bellagio, accept that the night requires a separate transport plan. Knowing where you will finish the celebration is more useful than selecting a restaurant first and working out the journey afterwards.

Do not assume earlier years’ road closures, free transport or pickup points apply on December 31, 2026. Check the city’s and transport operator’s current notices near your travel date and compare the arrival point with your event’s entry instructions. Old event maps can remain on official websites while being unsuitable for the current edition. For the journey home, agree on an identifiable meeting point, keep your phone charged and save your accommodation address. That preparation is more dependable than building the entire return plan around finding a car immediately after the countdown.

sections.heading: Pack for admission checks and leave room for changes
paragraphs: Bring only a small bag that meets the event’s current rules. Fremont restricts large backpacks, glass containers and professional recording equipment among other items. The museum also limits luggage and photographic accessories. Leaving suitcases and unnecessary equipment at your accommodation before heading out is the simplest approach. Carry the identification accepted by the organizer, a downloaded confirmation and a payment method suitable for the museum, where cash is not accepted. Check the requirements for each member of the group rather than assuming a lead booker can handle every admission.

Pack layers for queues and outdoor visits. If weather deteriorates, check operational notices directly: Fremont’s final-sale policy does not automatically become a refund entitlement because of rain, while the museum can modify activities for safety. For a group with children or anyone under 21, rule out Fremont as the shared celebration from the start and plan an evening with activities that explicitly admit those ages. The garden and museum described here are cultural visits with their own rules; neither is presented as a guaranteed family celebration continuing until midnight.

itinerary: December 30: visit Bellagio Conservatory at a time compatible with the hotel’s confirmed access instructions. Leave an unhurried meal break and use another block for your booked Neon Museum admission. If the available museum slot makes the day rushed, move it to January 1. Two well-paced visits are more useful than collecting reservations without enough time to enjoy them.

December 31: keep the daytime schedule light. Handle identification and wristband collection according to Fremont’s instructions, eat before entry and allow a generous margin for reaching downtown. Treat the published 7 p.m. time as doors opening, not a promise of admission without a queue. Once there, commit to your chosen celebration instead of trying to alternate it with another party on the Strip.

January 1: avoid obligations that require an early start after the celebration. If Bellagio remains on your list, the Holiday display is scheduled through January 2. If you book the museum for this day, pay particular attention to your admission time because the new pricing rule begins in 2027. Verify availability before making either visit a fixed commitment.

faq.question: Does Las Vegas New Year 2027 take place on December 31, 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The night welcoming 2027 runs from December 31, 2026, into January 1, 2027. When buying, check that the ticket confirmation states the correct edition, date and entry time. A page headed New Year is not enough on its own to establish that an older event map or ticket applies.

faq.question: Is the Fremont New Year party free, and can children attend?
faq.answer: Countdown Under The Canopy is offered as a separately ticketed event exclusively for adults aged 21 and over. Identification is required even if you already have a wristband. Do not extend Fremont’s usual access arrangements to this special night or buy for a group with children expecting an exception.

faq.question: Can I visit Bellagio and The Neon Museum on January 1?
faq.answer: Bellagio lists its Holiday installation through January 2, 2027, and the museum says it opens all year. Check actual access and ticket availability before arranging your day. At the museum, the rule allowing an additional charge for admission outside your selected time begins on January 1.

faq.question: Does this route include fireworks viewing or nightclub admission?
faq.answer: No. These are three places with separate products and conditions, without a guaranteed fireworks view or club entry. If either is your main aim, verify the relevant organizer’s 2026–2027 announcement and buy a product that explicitly includes it. General admission somewhere else does not establish those benefits.

faq.question: How many nights should I allow for this itinerary?
faq.answer: Two nights can separate the museum and garden from the main party, although flight times may justify three. Avoid nonrefundable reservations immediately after arrival and do not require a quick cross-city journey after midnight. Fit the sightseeing around the real booking calendar rather than forcing the calendar to match an ambitious checklist.

conclusion: New Year in Las Vegas becomes a more rounded trip when the party and sightseeing have room of their own. Fremont offers a ticketed adults-only celebration, Bellagio extends its holiday atmosphere into early January, and The Neon Museum adds history and design. Choose one base for the countdown, review the current conditions before paying and preserve enough flexibility to walk, eat and return without rushing.
